plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai replay failed to locate 'Last Name' input because the live survey form displays different form fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email', 'Occupation').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred inside .cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js while executing in DETERMINISTIC replay mode.
Selector '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' failed because the live page renders 'Your Name' and 'Contact Email' instead.
The test's high-level objective ('Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...') is semantically flexible and easily satisfied by a fresh autonomous execution.
Zero application console errors or network failures detected.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the cached Page.AI file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) and re-run the test autonomously so Page.AI can generate fresh selectors matching the live survey fields.

plan.notes: The survey page structure varies between runs. The cached instructions expected 'Last Name' but the page currently presents 'Your Name'. Regenerating the cache with a fresh autonomous run will adapt to the current form fields.
